name: json-mcp-lite
description: Turn any JSON file into read-only list, search and get tools.
long_description: Pick a JSON file (catalogue, FAQ, price list) and get three read-only tools: list with paging, keyword search across chosen fields, and get by id.

tools.name: records_list
tools.description: List records with limit/offset paging (prefix = the Name setting)

tools.name: records_search
tools.description: Keyword search; every word must match, case-insensitive

tools.name: records_get
tools.description: One record by its id field

file.title: JSON file
file.description: A JSON file whose root is an array of records

id.title: Id field
id.description: Field used to fetch one record

search.title: Search fields
search.description: Comma-separated fields to search, e.g. title,description
